sense: of a place: lie in a direction

terms.gloss: of a place: lie towards, face, slope towards
terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, with ad or in + acc.
evidence: Caes. B.G. 1.1: Galliae pars ad septentriōnēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short calls this the classical sense of the word: a place, a building or a slope “inclines” towards a quarter. Perfect and supine are not found.

sources: Lewis & Short: vergo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 339.
